spec.founder_expression: Watch my uniimente-kernel checkout and make sure its HEAD commit is recorded; tell me if it is dirty.
spec.intended_effect: Continuously observe the local uniimente-kernel git checkout at /home/user/uniimente-kernel: capture its current HEAD commit SHA on a recurring cadence, and detect/report whether the working tree has uncommitted changes (dirty), notifying the founder when a dirty state is observed.

success_checks.description: The current HEAD commit SHA of the uniimente-kernel checkout has been captured via a read-only git inspection.
The working tree's clean/dirty status has been observed via a read-only git status check.

strategies.rationale: A read-only git rev-parse against the checkout path is the simplest, lowest-consequence mechanism to record the current HEAD commit SHA, satisfying the founder's 'make sure its HEAD commit is recorded' requirement without inventing new tooling.
strategies.expected_outcome: The current HEAD commit SHA string is returned and recorded as evidence.

strategies.rationale: A read-only porcelain status check is the standard, lowest-consequence way to determine whether the checkout has uncommitted changes, directly answering 'tell me if it is dirty'.
strategies.expected_outcome: Empty output indicates a clean tree; any lines indicate uncommitted changes (dirty).

strategies.rationale: The founder explicitly asked to be told when the checkout is dirty; mac.notify is the registered, already-attached capability for reaching the founder directly and is reversible and low-consequence (a local notification, not an external message to a third party).
strategies.expected_outcome: Founder receives a local notification only when the working tree is observed to be dirty; no notification is sent when clean.

constraints: Only read the /home/user/uniimente-kernel checkout; do not modify, commit, stage, or push anything in it.
Notification action targets only the founder himself, never a third party.
No network or external-contact actions are authorized by this mission.
unacceptable_outcomes: Fabricating a HEAD commit SHA or dirty/clean status without an actual git.inspect invocation.
Modifying the working tree or committing changes to make it appear clean.

clamped: cone limited to the read-only capabilities the plan uses

notes: drafted by a model; review every check and strategy before signing
